d: A nurse responding to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been killed by an angry mob, while another health worker was seriously injured. The attack highlights growing challenges in containing the virus, as fear and misinformation fuel hostility towards frontline workers. Meanwhile, Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya, and new quarantine measures in Uganda, have raised concerns across Africa. Can authorities contain the outbreak as mistrust threatens the fight against Ebola? Palki Sharma tells you.
